verdict.rationale: Angular's docs claim fine-grained reactivity via Signals for fast state updates, and community users credit Angular 2's AOT compilation and strong rendering performance. No first-party evidence explicitly says the compiler turns templates into targeted DOM update instructions, so the compiler-to-surgical-updates link is only implied. The dirty-checking complaints concern AngularJS's $digest loop, so they don't concretely contradict modern Angular. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the compiler generating targeted DOM updates, explanation of how compiled templates combine with Signals, independent hands-on corroboration on current Angular versions.
